scope: the fibroblast family carrier on the optic-nerve side: the exclusion table removes the only reachable carrier of the family for optic-nerve-declared clusters while the legitimate generic fibroblast panel shares none of their window, so a coarse-but-family-correct answer degrades to an abstention
status: staging only; library `onfibro_v13` is NOT merged into the default `all` set and has an EMPTY whitelist, so the default route is byte-identical in every state. Activating a default face is a separate PI decision and is not made here.
source_corpus: the served in-repo literature corpus (v2.6-dev lineage) indexed at build time; corpus path is not distributed
scope_tissues_provenance: the family is legitimate in every ocular tissue the exclusion table speaks about; the entry does not name a tissue-specific identity, it carries the generic family and is named by the generic ontology term

admission_rule.closed_candidate_set: motivating window (10) + shipped generic Fibroblast panel (10) = 20 symbols; n4a also profiled the 3 genes of the shipped limbal/scleral entry
admission_rule.rule2: measurable in the assay (project gene vocabulary)
admission_rule.rule3: >=2 corpus chunks in a fibroblast context, >=1 of them ocular
admission_rule.rule4: not already attached by a shipped library to a non-fibroblast KB class
admission_rule.retention: genes of the shipped generic panel are retained unconditionally (deepening must not lose identity genes)

entries.cl_overlap_note: CL:0000057 is the term of the shipped generic `Fibroblast` entry in kb/markers/markers_membrane_v1.json (10 genes). This entry is the same cell type with a deepened panel; the membrane body is untouched. The two entries differ in library, so the merged route presents them as separate alias rows and no ranking carries one class twice.
entries.why: the family's coarse carrier, deepened with the evidence-passing genes of the motivating window so the >=2 shared-gene bar can be cleared
